items.title: XRP Ledger retries upgrade that lets banks split payment and compliance duties
items.summary: The upgrade could activate Oct. 5, letting businesses give another account limited powers such as making payments or approving customers without handing over full control.

items.title: Solana starts testing upgrade that could cut finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds
items.summary: Alpenglow would let exchanges, bridges and merchants treat payments as irreversible almost immediately.

items.title: Zcash’s November upgrade could freeze funds in legacy Sprout pool
items.summary: The proposed NU7 change would disable version 4 transactions, leaving ZEC in Zcash’s legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable.

items.title: U.S. regulator warns about cheating risks in 'mention markets' on prediction platforms
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued a new advisory to flag the unique dangers of markets based on individuals' behavior.

items.title: Bitcoin bull market ‘confirmed’ but $90K presents profit-taking risk: Analysis
items.summary: BTC price analysis concluded that onchain signals had “confirmed” the new Bitcoin bull market.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic to brief UN Security Council on AI risks: Reports
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are expected to brief the UN Security Council as it examines AI risks and global security.

items.title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts
items.summary: The warning comes weeks after the CFTC fined a former White House teleprompter operator who made more than $107,000 trading prediction contracts tied to President Trump’s speeches.

items.title: Bitcoin recovers from Asian-session lows as falling oil price supports risk appetite
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $86,000 as WTI crude dropped below $90 and strong stock markets supported risk appetite.

items.title: ECB, EU cenbanks seek changes in MiCA’s minimum bank deposit for stablecoins
items.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

items.title: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years
items.summary: The exchange, co-founded by Arthur Hayes, stopped trading and deposits, but says users can still log in and withdraw funds as its wind-down continues.

items.title: FTX, Alameda-linked wallets send $75 million in ether to Wintermute, onchain data shows
items.summary: Onchain analysts PeckShield and EmberCN say the funds moved to a Wintermute wallet, but neither a sale nor the purpose of the transfer have been confirmed.

items.title: Bitcoin's on a streak it hasn't hit since 2012

items.title: Zcash leads crypto majors with a 10% gain as bitcoin holds near $87,000
items.summary: Falling oil eased inflation worries through the Asian session, while a bill to make the government's bitcoin stockpile permanent moved further through Congress than any before it.

items.title: EU watchdogs warn quantum computers could pick crypto’s locks
items.summary: EU supervisors warn quantum computing could weaken blockchain security as Bitcoin developers weigh a draft migration plan and Ethereum targets 2029.

items.summary: Michael Selig said tokenization could reshape financial markets as the CFTC and SEC continue advancing onchain initiatives despite the CLARITY Act setback.
